source: two REAL_ROOT brains registered internally (task0041-seed-proof.py) -> real fs create/modify/delete/rename/move outside the process -> real Actualiser / Reconstruire clicks -> map_refresh / map_rebuild round trips observed on the wire (CDP Network) -> mode, summary and revision read from the real panels that render those reports (summary, discreet mode label, Changements, filters, details)
limits: No personal brain: both analysed trees were generated by task0041-seed-proof.py and die with the proof root

The path that applied each scan is read from the discreet applicationMode label the real product renders from the real map_refresh / map_rebuild report (the body of a custom-protocol response is not retrievable through CDP, so the wire is used for completion and success only); the "never a full replacement" guard, SQL-failure rollback and root-identity refusal are proved at the Rust level (refresh_incremental_tests), not by breaking the real host
Modification is driven by a size change (deterministic); a timestamp-only change is proved at the Rust level
The scan stays complete on every Actualiser (F-029 manual, O(corpus)); nothing here measures scan cost or the watcher (F-030, out of scope)
